annotations.title: Get a style reference and its study

description: One style reference with the server's study of its uploaded video: where the cuts fall, shot lengths, cuts per 10 seconds, size and aspect, and a sheet of frames (the first 3 seconds' hook, then one frame from each shot) shown to you as an image and at sheet_url (a private link for an hour). Read the on-screen text, fonts, framing and color from the sheet; take pacing from cuts. study_status queued or running: ask again in a minute. To look closer at moments, call style_reference_study with at_s.

idempotency_key.description: Any unique string, e.g. a UUID. A retry with the same key within 24 hours returns the first call's result instead of doing it again.
